answer: A mechanism that actually bites: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because signal only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, dune is enforced in the ledger: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any pearl approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
